Record Class WhoPaths

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.jwcarman.who.spring.security.WhoPaths
Record Components:
root - a path such as /who: starting with /, not ending with one, and with no wildcard, template, query, fragment, parameter or whitespace characters
public record WhoPaths(String root) extends Record
Where every who endpoint lives: one root, such as /who (the default) or /auth, and each endpoint's path below it. Sign-in methods, who's own filters and /me all take their paths from here, so they cannot disagree.
